name: vibe-editor
description: Turn Claude into your reel editor. Drop a raw video, say what you want, get a finished reel: auto-cut pauses and retakes, 47 caption styles (Hindi, Hinglish and 8 Indian scripts), 90+ motion effects, UI mockups, charts, AI cut-out effects (text behind you, stickers, background swap, clones), 36 looks, 50 sounds, 70+ fonts, cover and post caption. Match any reference style and add your own fonts, sounds and colour grades.
